deployment: theborg cicd namespace (concourse.home), configured by home-infra apps/concourse.yaml

web.tracing.uncovered: Spans go to the cluster's Tempo; the tier has no reader for them. testhelpers/otel asserts export end to end and is kept out of CI because it needs tempo.home and loki.home.

web.tls.note: TLS terminates at the Traefik ingress.

web.hangarOutput.note: The Hangar output plane is in service here since 2026-11-03 (home-infra, hangar_cluster_rollout_test.go's steps: bootstrap Secrets, the disk store, the daemons' plane, then hangarOutput.webEnabled), so the landing queue's compose and land Runs can publish results. The web writes its hangar_enabled row from webEnabled; there is no activation step. To take it out, follow docs/hangar.md's drain.

web.hangarOutputCapture.note: On with web.hangarOutput: hangarOutput.webEnabled renders capture and the Run input signing key. The named tests run a managed-input Run, a review Run and an implement Run on the disk store and download and verify each result against its binding (hangar_one_daemon A8); the review and implement tests also need the fixture review worker pinned in web.runCredentialWorkerImages (k8s-live-tests reads CONCOURSE_LIVE_REVIEW_WORKER_IMAGE back from web's flags) and fail naming the missing pin until it is.

daemon.hangarOutput.note: The output plane is mounted in every artifact daemon (--execution-control, verifying every warrant with the Hangar key concourse-hangar-warrant-key) with capture on the disk store. Every Run input reaches a task through it, as a managed read of an input publication.

store.disk.note: The Hangar disk store (hangarStorage.disk, cmd/hangar-store) runs here as store ID concourse-home-3 on a local-path PVC on theborg whose PV is Retain. Its restart contract is also covered by TestLiveHangarDiskStoreRoundTripSurvivesRestart in the k8s-e2e pipeline's hangar-disk-store-contract job, on a throwaway K3s cluster.

daemon.mirrorReplicas.uncovered: Mirroring copies each output to a peer daemon. This cluster has two daemon nodes (daemon.nodes), but k3s-agent-y is a desktop VM that sleeps, so mirroring is live only while it is up and no live test can count on a peer. Cross-node mirroring is covered by cmd/artifact-daemon's behavioral_cross_node_test.go with two daemons on one host; cross-node artifact handoff on this cluster by brine's live-multinode tier, which runs only when both nodes are up.

daemon.nodes.uncovered: Not a feature: asserted so a change in how many nodes run a daemon -- which decides whether mirroring has a peer -- fails this test until daemon.mirrorReplicas says what covers it. Counted from the registered nodes the DaemonSet can place on, so a node that is asleep (NotReady) still counts.
